title: Manifest cleanup required special-file and foreign-process safeguards
title_de: Manifest-Cleanup erforderte Schutzvorkehrungen für Spezialdateien und fremde Prozesse
summary: The native runtime manifest is partial because cleanup correctly refused two symlinked temporary paths; no manual deletion is authorized.
summary_de: Das Native-Runtime-Manifest ist partial, weil Cleanup zwei symlinked Temporary-Pfade korrekt verweigerte; manuelle Löschung ist nicht autorisiert.

current_task_update.root_cause: The cleanup planner needed fail-closed special-file, retained-evidence, and per-operation foreign-process checks before descriptor-anchored deletion.
current_task_update.security_assessment: Validated storage boundary hardening: control cases reject FIFO, socket, mount, symlink, manifest tampering, retained-evidence mismatch, and an injected foreign-process reference before a later deletion. FND-PARENT-0014 separately records the unproven atomic same-UID leaf-identity boundary between final validation and removal.
current_task_update.runtime_limitation: No external runtime directory was deleted; tests use task-owned temporary paths only.
current_task_update.strict_same_uid_disposition: partial; FND-PARENT-0014 remains blocked and no same-UID no-foreign-leaf-deletion guarantee is made.

root_cause: The retained historical evidence was expanded by a current Parent-only source root cause and verified remediation.
root_cause_de: Die retained Evidence belegt den Zustand, aber keine Produktcode-Grundursache.
proposed_remediation: Define a safe, owner-authorized retention or cleanup procedure for symlinked task paths without following links.
proposed_remediation_de: Eine sichere, owner-autorisierte Retention- oder Cleanup-Prozedur für symlinked Task-Pfade definieren, ohne Links zu folgen.
acceptance_criteria: Each retained symlinked path has an owner, retention decision, and safe disposal procedure.
No cleanup follows a symlink or removes data outside the task-owned run.
validation_plan: Inspect object types with no symlink traversal.
Run the storage helper's safe dry-run/finalization controls only on registered paths.
regression_tests: Add or retain a focused regression/evidence control for the recorded condition.
legitimate_control_tests: Run the unaffected allow/control behavior in the same scoped environment.
residual_risk: The condition remains open; no risk has been accepted by the current user.
residual_risk_de: Der Zustand bleibt offen; der aktuelle Benutzer hat kein Risiko akzeptiert.
